cases.question: Why is Nvidia down today? What's the news catalyst?
cases.result_summary: Returned dated per-article catalysts (2026-08-27): NVDA actually SURGED +7-9% on a Q2 blowout ($96.2B rev +106%, Q3 guide $108B, Vera Rubin ramp). Also OpenAI 'Jalapeno' inference chip beating GB200 (competition/neg, rel 0.8), Broadcom AI-share threat (neg 0.6), Micron memory-cost margin drag (neg 0.9). Impact aspects + net_direction drawn from news, dup_count present.
cases.reason: Concrete dated catalysts returned; sentiment from news not guessed. Premise ('down today') is factually false — news shows NVDA up — the tool honestly surfaces the real (positive) catalyst rather than fabricating a down-narrative, which is exactly what acceptance requires.

defects.desc: Tool has no price-move field to let the client detect the false 'down today' premise directly; it must infer direction from article text. Minor — impact.net_direction + brief_text made it obvious.

cases.question: Where is options positioning most extreme right now — any names with unusually stretched put/call or crowded positioning I should know about?
cases.result_summary: 15 futures markets at 3-year positioning extremes (>=90th/<=10th pct) with net_pct_oi, percentile_3y, z_3y and plain-language read. E.g. UST-2Y (100th, positioned for lower yields), COPPER(99th long), KC-WHEAT(99th), EURUSD(2nd, crowded short), QQQ/IWM equity-index shorts near bottom. All framed vs 3y range = 'extreme relative to norm'.
cases.reason: Positioning extremes returned from real COT data, framed vs a 3y range, current — strong on the 'crowded positioning' half. But this is the FUTURES/COT lens (commodities/FX/rates/equity-index), NOT single-name equity OPTIONS put/call; the user explicitly asked for 'stretched put/call' names. options_sentiment exists per-ticker but there is no market-wide 'which OPTION names are most extreme' scan, so the equity put/call ask can't be fully served in one call.

defects.desc: No market-wide equity-options-extreme screen. positioning_extremes covers only futures COT (no equity single-name put/call); options_sentiment is per-ticker only. A user asking 'which names have stretched put/call right now' has no tool that ranks the ~547 optionable names by an options-positioning extreme.

cases.question: Between AMD, Intel and Micron — who had the better week on news? Rank them by impact.
cases.result_summary: All three over 7d with dated items. MU: strongest — 84.9% gross margin beating NVDA, $41.46B rev, HBM4 for Vera Rubin, ~$100B contracted (impact_score 4-5, net-pos). INTC: net-pos — DC/AI rev +59%, Foundry +31%, +3.6% on-day, HSBC PT hike (score 3-4). AMD: net-pos but more diffuse — Anthropic MI450 2GW deal + $5B stake, though dipped ~1% intraday vs peers (score 4). Cross-referenced by the shared 'AI chip stocks mixed' article. Ranking derivable: MU > INTC ~ AMD.
cases.reason: All three tickers covered over a 1-week window with concrete dated news per name; a head-to-head impact ranking (MU strongest) is justified from the returned reasons/impact_scores, no name padded.

defects.desc: No single 3-ticker comparative call; client fans out 3 stock_impact calls then ranks. Fine but not a one-shot compare surface.

top_defects: ne-06 (mcp-guidance): no market-wide EQUITY options put/call extreme screen — positioning_extremes is futures/COT only, options_sentiment is per-ticker only, so 'which names have stretched put/call right now' can't be answered in one call.
